comment: Dr. Roderick's lectures are amazing, engaging, and super helpful for tests. She has high expectations but she provides great feedback to help you improve. Overall, she is super kind and likes to have fun in class.
Great prof. Super understanding and doesn't make things overcomplicated or difficult.

Dr.Roderick was an outstanding professor who knows the material well and has a passion for educating on it. She does a great job of cutting unnecessary content from an overly in-depth book to create a well-rounded introductory course. She was also extremely friendly and always willing to answer questions.

Dr. R is a great professor and I would recommend her endlessly. She tries to get to know her students and is very understanding of our time and lives outside of class. Her lectures are entertaining and it is very easy to do well in her class.

Dr. Roderick is a very good professor especially for it being her semester at UR. The textbook readings are very long and you don't really need much of the information in them, but besides that it is a fairly easy and interesting class. Final Project was very easy as well and would definitely recommend her.
